fields.description: Aila Homes is Al Hamra’s three- and four-bedroom townhouse community in Ras Al Khaimah. Its low-rise homes sit alongside landscaped spaces, with an emphasis on outdoor activity and everyday family life.

overview: Compare the attached and semi-detached layouts: built-up area and plot area measure different parts of each home.
research.locationNote: The branded brochure places Aila within Al Hamra Village, near RAK Central. Wider marina, mall and yacht-club facilities are community destinations, not private-home inclusions.
research.priceNote: Property Finder lists an AED 2.9 million launch reference; Dubainary’s July 2026 guide starts at AED 3,686,040. A current developer price was not verified.
research.paymentNote: Secondary reference only: 20% booking, 30% construction, 50% handover. No original dated developer schedule was verified; reconfirm applicable instalments and fees.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder forecasts Q4 2028; Dubainary gives Q2 2028. No current developer completion target was verified, so neither is treated as confirmed.

facts.label: Published unit counts
facts.value: Developer’s September 2025 article: 200 homes. Branded editions: 204 and 210; scope is unresolved.

facts.label: Area discrepancies
facts.value: Expanded brochure plots: 2,109/2,900 ft² for the 3BR types. Some broker summaries mistake the 4BR plot for its built-up area.

facts.label: Whole-home layouts
facts.value: Ground and first floors share one BUA; maid’s rooms are additional service rooms, not extra bedrooms.

facts.label: Broker instalment detail
facts.value: Dubainary shows six quarterly 3% payments at months 3–18, then 4% at months 21/24/27; these sum to the 30% construction portion.

unresolved: Confirm the contracted plot, built-up area, current charges, tenure, furnishing specification and delivery date.
Published sales percentages are historical, not live inventory.
